title: A Word From Pastor
body: God is not asking you to have it all figured out today — only to take the next faithful step. We're praying for you this week.

title: A Word From Pastor
body: Whatever season you're walking through, you don't walk through it alone. Your church family is with you.

title: A Word From Pastor
body: Keep showing up — to prayer, to worship, to community. Faithfulness in small things is never wasted.
